value.rationale: The rank-wise unital subalgebra lattice is a canonical invariant of the free cube-zero local ring, relevant to general subring-zeta enumeration. The exact full polynomial and the sharp one-dimensional cotangent-image concentration as embedding dimension grows identify structural behavior invisible to naive vector-subspace counts. Scope is natural for all embedding dimensions and all finite fields, not an arbitrary table entry.
